sources.snippet: OmniShotCut is a sensitive and more informative SoTA for Shot Boundary Detection. OmniShotCut can detect shot changes of the video in diverse sources (anime, vlog, game, shorts, sports, screen recording, etc.), and recognize Sudden Jump and Transitions (dissolve, fade, wipe, etc.) by proposing a Shot-Query-based Video Transformer.
